integrity: The foundational 1975 model, publication date, and mathematical classification were verified from bibliographic records. Prior work on mean values was explicitly separated from the new conditional statement. Open same-object sources on integrability/global dynamics and a complete modern deterministic/stochastic May–Leonard treatment were compared at statement and implication level. The invariant-simplex reduction, logarithmic generator tests, fiberwise conditional means, and aggregate fluctuation identity were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The invariant measure must have compact support in the strictly positive octant.
The theorem is restricted to the neutral surface \(\alpha+\beta=2\) and excludes \(\alpha=\beta=1\).
The result does not apply directly to boundary heteroclinic invariant measures.
Global mean values and the invariant simplex are prior phenomena and are excluded from the originality claim.
A differently phrased conditional-moment observation could remain in unindexed ecological-dynamics literature.
title: Fiberwise barycentric calibration on the neutral May–Leonard simplex
